article_manifest.title: Mali: The army seizes 2,000 radios intended for armed groups near Timbuktu
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : l’armée saisit 2 000 radios destinées à des groupes armés près de Tombouctou
article_manifest.summary: On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa) announced that they had intercepted a large consignment of communications equipment consisting of 2,000 portable radios, a pick-up truck and eight motorcycles, north of Timbuktu, as part of an operation to dismantle suspected supply chains for armed terrorist groups. . According to an army report, the interception took place on Monday, 9 November, during Operation Dougoukoloko, conducted under the supervision of Colonel Cheick Abdoul Kader Diarra, Chief of Operations at the Sector 3 Coordination Centre.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Journalist Serge Mathurin Adou released after two years in prison
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: le journaliste Serge Mathurin Adou libéré après deux ans de prison
article_manifest.summary: In the preparation of the plot that the Burkinabe authorities claimed to have thwarted in 2024, they accused the Nigerien-Ivorian journalist Serge Mathurin Adou, along with around fifteen prominent figures from Burkina Faso, including Lieutenant Colonel Paul-Henri Damiba, the former coup leader, himself overthrown by Captain Ibrahim Traoré, and the former ministers Djibrill Bassolé and Alpha Barry, with Ahmed Kinda as the head of operations, the former commander of the Special Forces.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Journalist Serge Mathurin Adou released after two years in prison
article_manifest.original_title: Niger: le journaliste Serge Mathurin Adou libéré après deux ans de prison
article_manifest.summary: In Niger, journalist Serge Mathurin Adou was released on Wednesday, 11 November 2026, after two years in prison. He had been convicted of undermining state security following accusations of conspiracy from neighbouring Burkina Faso. .

article_manifest.title: Drug trafficking in Zinder: 54,000 psychotropic tablets seized by OCRTIS, a 32-year-old man arrested
article_manifest.original_title: Trafic de stupéfiants à Zinder : 54 000 comprimés psychotropes saisis par l’OCRTIS, un homme de 32 ans interpellé
article_manifest.summary: The regional branch of the Central Office for the Suppression of Illicit Drug Trafficking (OCRTIS) in Zinder intercepted 54,000 tablets of psychotropic substances during a roadside check at the edge of the city. A 32-year-old Nigerien, who was travelling on a public transport vehicle from Gouré, was arrested on 8 November 2026. He reportedly stated that he wanted to transport the products to Tibarkaten to sell them there.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Mali-Türkiye: Military technological cooperation deemed necessary in the face of security challenges
article_manifest.original_title: Mali-Türkiye : la coopération militaire technologique jugée nécessaire face aux défis sécuritaires
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) Turkish defence technologies could strengthen the operational capabilities of the Malian army and help address the shortage of military personnel, according to the Permanent Secretary of the National Security Council, retired Major General Yamoussa Camara. . Speaking on the sidelines of the BAMEX 2026 trade fair in Bamako, he stressed that securing Malian territory, which covers an area of 1.24 million km², requires resources that the army's current budgetary resources do not always allow it to mobilise.

article_manifest.title: DSS Intercepts Arms Shipment From Niger Republic In Sokoto, Arrests Female Courier
article_manifest.original_title: DSS Intercepts Arms Shipment From Niger Republic In Sokoto, Arrests Female Courier
article_manifest.summary: The Department of State Services (DSS) has intercepted a large consignment of weapons and ammunition smuggled into Nigeria from the Niger Republic, a security source has disclosed. The weapons, comprising 21 AK-47 rifles, four PKT machine guns and 825 magazines, were intercepted by DSS operatives in Dawakawa, Goronyo Local Government Area of Sokoto State, following surveillance of suspected terrorist networks.

article_manifest.title: Mali: Goïta receives three foreign delegations regarding military cooperation
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : Goïta reçoit trois délégations étrangères autour de la coopération militaire
article_manifest.summary: On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, in Bamako, the President of Mali's Transition, Army General Assimi Goïta, received official delegations from Türkiye, Chad and Uganda, who had come to attend the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 2026) for discussions focused on military partnerships and African security challenges. . The three meetings took place at the Koulouba Palace on the third day of the trade fair, which brings together military officials, institutional representatives and defence industry professionals in the Malian capital.

article_manifest.title: FAMa: three airstrikes against...
article_manifest.original_title: FAMa : trois frappes aériennes contre...
article_manifest.summary: FAMa: Three airstrikes against terrorist positions in Kidal, Timbuktu and Sikasso The General Staff of the Armed Forces announces new military operations as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, carried out several precision strikes on 10 and 11 November 2026 against identified targets in the Kidal, Timbuktu and Sikasso regions.

article_manifest.title: Mali-Türkiye cooperation: Towards a strengthened security partnership
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération Mali-Türkiye : Vers un partenariat sécuritaire renforcé
article_manifest.summary: Cooperation between Mali and Türkiye: a strategic partnership to strengthen security On Wednesday, 11 November 2026, the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly MOHAMMEDINE, received an important Turkish delegation led by the Deputy Minister of National Defence of the Republic of Türkiye, His Excellency Mr Bilal DURDALI. . This meeting, held on the sidelines of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 26), is part of the strengthening of cooperative relations between Mali and Türkiye, particularly in the field of security.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: AES Confederation: Ministers meet in Ouagadougou to assess the Year II roadmap
article_manifest.original_title: Confédération AES : les ministres réunis à Ouagadougou pour évaluer la feuille de route de l’An II
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) The ministers of the member states of the Confederation of Sahel States (AES) are meeting on Wednesday and Thursday in Ouagadougou to assess the implementation of the Year II roadmap and to formulate recommendations in preparation for the next session of the College of Heads of State. The discussions will focus on the three pillars of the Confederation: Defence and Security, Diplomacy and Development.

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Fight against drugs: EMP-ABB auditors spend time at the Central Office for Narcotics
article_manifest.original_title: Lutte contre la drogue : Les auditeurs de l’EMP-ABB en immersion à l’Office central des stupéfiants
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) – On Wednesday, the Central Office for Narcotics (OCS) welcomed the 4th cohort of the Master's in Peacekeeping and State Reconstruction from the Alioune Blondin Bèye Peacekeeping School (EMP-ABB), as part of a professional immersion visit focused on the operational realities of combating illicit drug trafficking and organised crime, AMAP reported.

article_manifest.title: People deported from Guinea: returns are being organised, the human toll remains to be determined
article_manifest.original_title: Refoulés de Guinée : les retours s’organisent, le bilan humain reste à préciser
article_manifest.summary: RIGHT NOW Between the border post, the reception sites and the departure points, operations are entering a new phase. The Malian and Burkinabé authorities are now organising convoys from several assembly points in order to reduce the long internal journeys imposed on people leaving the gold mining areas of Guinea. .

article_manifest.title: Security: 75 pick-up trucks and 25 motorcycles handed over to the Police and the Gendarmerie
article_manifest.original_title: Sécurité : 75 pick-up et 25 motos remis à la Police et à la Gendarmerie
article_manifest.summary: On Friday, 6 November 2020, the Minister of Security and Civil Protection, Major General Daoud Aly Mohammedine, handed over a batch of vehicles to the National Police and the National Gendarmerie. . Funded by the national budget, this allocation includes 75 Toyota pick-up trucks for the Police's rapid response units, as well as 25 high-capacity motorcycles for the presidential escorts provided by the Gendarmerie.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: FAMa strike terrorist positions in Tinzaouatène, Tonka, and near Sikasso
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : les FAMa frappent des positions terroristes à Tinzaouatène, Tonka et près de Sikasso
article_manifest.summary: Operation Dougoukoloko: The FAMa strike terrorist positions in Tinzaouatène, Tonka and near Sikasso The Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their operations to secure the territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. Several strikes carried out over the past two days have been reviewed by the General Staff of the Armed Forces.

article_manifest.title: Operation Dougoukoloko: The Malian Army neutralises several terrorist targets in Tinzaouatène, Tonka and Sikasso
article_manifest.original_title: Opération Dougoukoloko : L’Armée malienne neutralise plusieurs objectifs terroristes à Tinzaouatène, Tonka et Sikasso
article_manifest.summary: The General Staff of the Armed Forces informs the national public that the Malian Armed Forces (FAMa), supported by their partners, are continuing their ongoing operations to monitor, control and secure the national territory as part of Operation Dougoukoloko. . On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, approximately twenty-seven (27) kilometres north-west of Tinzaouatène, in the Kidal region, a previously identified terrorist target was struck three (03) times.

article_manifest.title: MALIAN ARMED FORCES: The Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces inaugurates new facilities at Camp Sénou
article_manifest.original_title: FORCES ARMÉES MALIENNES : le Chef d’État-Major Général des Armées inaugure de nouvelles infrastructures au Camp de Sénou
article_manifest.summary: As part of the implementation of the strategic vision of the High Military Command, which focuses on strengthening the logistical capabilities of military bases and improving the well-being of personnel, the Chief of the General Staff of the Armed Forces (CEMGA), Major General Élisée Jean DAO, inaugurated a modern bakery and a soldiers' recreation centre at Camp Dassiri in Sénou on Monday, 9 November 2026.

article_manifest.title: BAMEX'26: A strengthened diplomatic and strategic axis at Koulouba At the Koulouba Palace, the Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, received delegations from Türkiye, Chad and Uganda on Wednesday, 11 November 2026. These high-level meetings, held on the sidelines of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX'26), embody a shared ambition: to embed military cooperation within a dynamic of continental sovereignty and integration.
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX’26 : Un axe diplomatique et stratégique renforcé à Koulouba Au Palais de Koulouba, le Président de la Transition, le Général d’armée Assimi Goïta, a reçu ce mercredi 11 novembre 2026 les délégations de la Türkiye, du Tchad et de l’Ouganda. Ces audiences de haut niveau, tenues en marge du Salon international de la défense et de la sécurité de Bamako (BAMEX’26), concrétisent une ambition partagée : ancrer la coopération militaire dans une dynamique de souveraineté et d’intégration continenta
article_manifest.summary: By opening the doors of the Presidency to these strategic delegations, the Head of State is giving substance to the scope of BAMEX'26, making security expertise a major diplomatic lever. Discussions held with Bilal Durdali, Deputy Minister of National Defence of Türkiye, General Issakha Malloua Djamous, Chadian Minister of the Armed Forces, and the Honourable Dr Hajjat Oleru Huda Abason, Ugandan Minister of State for Defence, provided an opportunity to address regional security challenges and the strengthening of technical partnerships.

article_manifest.title: Niger: Following protests in Niamey and Algiers, the EU spokesperson clarifies the EU’s position
article_manifest.original_title: Niger : après les protestations de Niamey et d’Alger, le porte-parole de l’UE clarifie la position de l’UE
article_manifest.summary: At a press briefing held on Tuesday, the European Union (EU) spokesperson, Anouar El-Anouni, revisited his comments on military cooperation between Niger and Algeria, stressing that “the European Union fully respects the sovereignty of both nations and has no intention of interfering”. He also clarified that "Algeria's decision to deploy troops to Niger is a matter for the bilateral relationship between Algeria and Niger" and that the EU had "at no time intended to ask either of these two partners for clarifications on their bilateral engagement".

article_manifest.title: Mali: The Malian army executes and mutilates five people in the Cercle of Kati, near Bamako
article_manifest.original_title: Mali: l'armée malienne exécute et mutile cinq personnes dans le cercle de Kati, près de Bamako
article_manifest.summary: Mali: The Malian army executes and mutilates five people in the Kati Cercle, near Bamako Five people were executed by the Malian army in the village of Daba, in the commune of Faladié, Kati Cercle, a few dozen kilometres from Bamako. The events, which took place on Thursday, 5 November, were revealed by the Fulani community association Jeunesse Pulaaku Internationale, which also reports genital mutilation.

article_manifest.title: Mali: AFRICOM chief received by Assimi Goïta in Bamako, despite the security alliance with Moscow
article_manifest.original_title: Mali : le chef d'AFRICOM reçu par Assimi Goïta à Bamako, malgré l'alliance sécuritaire avec Moscou
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, AFRICOM Commander General Dagvin Anderson met with Mali's Transitional President, Assimi Goïta, in Bamako, on the sidelines of the BAMEX defence exhibition. This meeting took place at a time when Bamako is relying on Moscow for its security AFRICOM's official X account described it as follows: "AFRICOM Commander General Dagvin Anderson attended BAMEX and met with Malian President Assimi Goïta in Bamako to discuss options for countering common threats, particularly JNIM and ISGS".

article_manifest.title: Algerian parliament rejects EU remarks on military deployment to Niger
article_manifest.original_title: Algerian parliament rejects EU remarks on military deployment to Niger
article_manifest.summary: A military parade to celebrate the 60th anniversary of Algeria’s independence, in its capital, Algiers, July 5, 2022. /VCG Algeria's Council of the Nation on Tuesday strongly rejected European Union (EU) remarks over Algeria's decision to deploy units of the People's National Army (ANP) to Niger at the Sahel country's request. In a statement, the council denounced what it described as an "arrogant and immature" intervention from abroad, accusing unnamed parties of attempting to interfere in the internal affairs of two sovereign countries and use the issue to serve their own political agendas.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso bans filming of returnees from Guinea during distribution of donations
article_manifest.original_title: Le Burkina Faso interdit de filmer les rapatriés de Guinée lors des distributions de dons
article_manifest.summary: On 10 November 2026, the Ministry of Family and Solidarity issued a statement welcoming a "wave of solidarity" towards Burkinabès forced to leave Guinea. While encouraging this mobilisation, it asks the initiators of these actions to ensure that the "dignity" of the beneficiaries is respected. As a reminder, since the end of October, Guinea has been carrying out operations against illegal gold panning following the suspension of artisanal gold mining.

article_manifest.title: Security cooperation: The Transitional President grants an audience to the Commander of AFRICOM
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération sécuritaire : Le Président de la Transition accorde une audience au commandant de l’AFRICOM
article_manifest.summary: BAMEX 2026: The Transitional President receives the Commander of AFRICOM. On Tuesday, 10 November 2026, the Transitional President and Head of State, His Excellency General Assimi Goïta, granted an audience to General Dagvin R. M.

article_manifest.title: Military and security cooperation: General Assimi Goïta receives an Iranian delegation on the sidelines of BAMEX 2026
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération militaire et sécuritaire : Le Général Assimi GOÏTA reçoit une délégation iranienne en marge du BAMEX 2026
article_manifest.summary: On the sidelines of the Bamako International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX), which is being held from 9 to 13 November 2026, the Transitional President, His Excellency Army General Assimi Goïta, Head of State, granted an audience on Tuesday, 10 November 2026, to an Iranian delegation led by Mr Abass Mohammadi, Deputy Minister for Industrial Affairs and Research at the Iranian Ministry of Defence.

article_manifest.title: Murder of pharmacist Abdourhamane Kodio: the death penalty sought against the three defendants
article_manifest.original_title: Meurtre du pharmacien Abdourhamane Kodio : la peine de mort requise contre les trois accusés
article_manifest.summary: Murder of pharmacist Abdourhamane Kodio: the death penalty sought against the three accused The trial of the three men accused of the murder of Dr Abdourhamane Kodio opened on Tuesday, 10 November 2026 before the Assize Court of Bamako. The pharmacist was shot dead during a robbery at his pharmacy in Kalaban-Coura ACI. .

article_manifest.title: BAMEX 2026: Bamako, the unmissable event for security and innovation
article_manifest.original_title: BAMEX 2026 : Bamako, le rendez-vous incontournable de la sécurité et de l’innovation
article_manifest.summary: On 9 November 2026, at the Bamako Exhibition Centre, the Prime Minister, Major General Abdoulaye Maïga, inaugurated the 2nd edition of BAMEX (International Defence and Security Exhibition), which is being held from 9 to 13 November. The event brought together a distinguished gathering of individuals, including diplomats, government officials, and military and civilian representatives.

article_manifest.title: Burkina Faso bans filming of returnees from Guinea during distribution of donations
article_manifest.original_title: Le Burkina Faso interdit de filmer les rapatriés de Guinée lors des distributions de dons
article_manifest.summary: On 10 November 2026, the Ministry of Family and Solidarity issued a statement welcoming a 'wave of solidarity' towards Burkinabès forced to leave Guinea. While encouraging this mobilisation, it asks the initiators of these actions to ensure that the "dignity" of the beneficiaries is respected. .

article_manifest.source: AMAP (Agence Malienne de Presse et de Publicité)
article_manifest.title: Cooperation: The Commander of US Africa Command welcomed at Koulouba
article_manifest.original_title: Coopération : le commandant des opérations militaires des USA pour l’Afrique reçu à Koulouba
article_manifest.summary: Bamako, 11 November (AMAP) The Commander of United States military operations in Africa, General Dagvin Anderson, was received on Tuesday by the Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, in Koulouba, AMAP observed. The U.S. general officer is visiting our country as part of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (Bamex), which has been underway since last Monday.

article_manifest.title: Mali–United States: Goïta and the head of AFRICOM discuss counter-terrorism
article_manifest.original_title: Mali–États-Unis : Goïta et le chef de l’AFRICOM discutent de la lutte antiterroriste
article_manifest.summary: On Tuesday, 10 November 2020, Mali's Transitional President, Army General Assimi Goïta, received the Commander of United States Africa Command (AFRICOM), General Dagvin Anderson, in Bamako for discussions on the terrorist threat in the Sahel and the prospects for security cooperation between the two countries. . The meeting took place at the Koulouba Palace, on the sidelines of the International Defence and Security Exhibition (BAMEX 2026), which opened on Monday in the Malian capital and in which the US military official is taking part.

article_manifest.title: Algeria-Niger. What's gotten into the EU spokesperson?
article_manifest.original_title: Algérie-Niger. Quelle mouche a piqué le porte-parole de l’UE?
article_manifest.summary: The statement in Brussels by a European Union spokesperson, who appeared to be speaking on his own initiative, provoked the anger of Algeria and Niger, who were outraged at being questioned about their military cooperation. The incident highlights the difficulty the European Commission has in extricating itself from French pressure and manoeuvring in the Sahel.

article_manifest.title: Recruitment of forty (40) security guards
article_manifest.original_title: Recrutement de quarante (40) agents de sécurité
article_manifest.summary: Recruitment of forty (40) security officers leFaso.net – News from Burkina Faso
